definitions.ask: Which name should replace article for the note type?
definitions.why: The only candidate that works at file and section scale with no vault or CLI collision

choices.label: Reads right as a note, a section, and a CLI noun; a mass noun, so copy says prose note
Countable, but every note is a page, refs already mean PDF pages, page section reads oddly

definitions.ask: Should prose notes keep numbering their headings by default?
definitions.why: Keeps the house style with no contract break; extraction will write false explicitly

choices.label: Default unchanged; turn numbering off per note with the new toggle command
Numbers only with section_numbers true; a ! break; sase_blog_contents opts in first

definitions.ask: Add a Prose Note glossary term (legacy alias article note) to SASE memory?
Add a decision record for the prose type's name, ownership rule, and permanent aliases?
